content: Build a 4KB chess engine for make.fun tiny-chess-01. Requirements: Python 3.13, <=4096 bytes main.py, deterministic fixed-node search, UCI protocol, no model calls, standard library only. Target: beat sunfish 4KB baseline (Elo ~1365 practice). Use mailbox 0x88 board representation, alpha-beta search with quiescence, PST evaluation.
I'll build a compact 0x88 mailbox chess engine with alpha-beta search, quiescence, and piece-square tables. Starting with the core board representation and move generation.
thinking: Need to design a chess engine under 4096 bytes. Key components: 0x88 board representation (128 squares, 0x88 offset for off-board detection), move generator for all pieces, alpha-beta search with fixed node budget, piece-square tables for evaluation, UCI protocol handler. Must be deterministic, no randomness, standard library only. Target ~2500 bytes to stay well under limit.

thinking: Alpha-beta with fixed node count (not time) for determinism. Quiescence search for captures and checks. Transposition table would be nice but bytes are tight. Using simple PST evaluation with material + position.
